title: The Google Play app review process now regularly takes longer than a week
summary: This content discusses how Google's app review process for the Play Store has become significantly slower, now regularly taking more than a week to complete. The post highlights developer frustration with these extended review times, which impact release schedules and app deployment workflows.
problem_solved: Documents the problem of slow Google Play app review times affecting developer productivity and release cycles.
why_valuable: Raises awareness about deteriorating developer experience on the Google Play platform and sparks discussion about platform policies affecting mobile developers.
